description: Import and Export Control Department - Imports and Exports (Control) Regulation No. 11 of 2021
categorisation: This gazette content promulgates new regulations under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 1 of 1969, specifically creating the "Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No. 11 of 2021." It establishes legal/regulatory frameworks for import control of specific goods (fertilizers) and modifies existing regulatory schedules. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the primary purpose of establishing legal regulations rather than detailing government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
